command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp

printf '574fa60f6d6bfb6c6a6b543edbb474725bea8860bd86d3e4e30348fcba0d0b91  scl_ndvi.py\n' | sha256sum -c || { echo 'FAIL: scl_ndvi.py does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
echo "== staged scene: 10 m red + NIR (10980^2), 20 m scene classification (5490^2), STAC item =="
ls -l /tmp/B04.tif /tmp/B08.tif /tmp/SCL.tif /tmp/item.json

python3 -u scl_ndvi.py > smoke-check.txt 2>&1 || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
cat smoke-check.txt
uname -m
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
